review_type: Fresh isolated Kami contract and PDF visual review
verdict: PASS within the stated PDF review scope; no P0 or P1 findings.

scope.independence: Reviewer did not author, edit or re-render the PDF or CAD. The review started from the content contract and inspected every supplied final page image.
performed: Read the Kami and PDF skills and Kami anti-pattern checklist.
Viewed all 12 final PNG page images at 1819 × 1287 pixels.
Read PDF metadata and checked every page MediaBox using PyMuPDF.
Re-ran the read-only Kami content and font checks.
Read existing dimension and native drawing audits, source notes and component CSV.
not_performed: No independent rasterization; visual findings apply to the supplied final PNG evidence.
No CAD rebuild, BRep geometry recomputation, native GUI operation, STEP roundtrip or web testing.
No independent authentication of historical source photographs, official specifications or electrical behavior.
Style, placeholders and density were reported passed by the parent; these gates were not re-run in this isolated review.

acceptance_checks.evidence: All 12 PDF MediaBoxes match 420 × 297 mm; all page images display the matching sequence and A3 footer.

acceptance_checks.item: all dimensions derived from saved BReps
acceptance_checks.note: Read model endpoints and values for 14 dimensions; visual labels and approximate notation are consistent. Underlying BReps were not independently recomputed.

acceptance_checks.evidence: All page images listed in reviewed_pages were opened and visually assessed.
27 atomic content values present; CJK body font TsangerJinKai02.

acceptance_checks.item: native TechDraw pages and measurable dimensions
acceptance_checks.note: Existing audit reports 12 pages and 14 passing native dimension references. No native application testing was performed by this reviewer.

preserve_checks.item: Official body reference and approximate local dimensions remain distinct
preserve_checks.note: Official 280 × 212 × 70 mm reference is named in explanatory copy, while drawing dimensions use approximate symbols and scope notes.
MEGADRIVE-0103, non-contiguous identifier ranges and the COMPONENTS.csv lookup are retained. Full cross-format identity was outside this PDF review.

preserve_checks.item: Original three-button controller and Japanese connection layout
preserve_checks.note: SJ-3500 direction/START/ABC control layout, front two DE-9 ports and headphone socket, rear interfaces and DIN-to-dual-RCA connection are presented consistently with the contract.

reviewed_pages.title: 初代日版主机总装与尺寸参考
reviewed_pages.observations: Isometric and top views are clearly separated; approximate 280 and 212 dimensions and extension lines are fully visible. Opening copy distinguishes official 280 × 212 × 70 mm from model details and explicitly identifies VA2 as a study reference.

reviewed_pages.title: 前后接口与接点细节
reviewed_pages.observations: Front and rear projections and three connector details are legible. The approximate 70.03 left dimension has a visible outer margin; approximate 25 detail dimension is unobstructed. Japanese rear connection layout is retained in the presented study.

reviewed_pages.title: 初代 SJ-3500 三键手柄外观
reviewed_pages.observations: ABC, START and direction controls are readable in the main views. Approximate 152 and 89.97 dimensions fit within the page; rear view shows six fixings and has a separate caption.

reviewed_pages.title: 手柄触点、板件与线束
reviewed_pages.observations: Large board and button/rubber views are readable; approximate 132 and 51 dimensions are clear. The smaller exploded strip provides an assembly overview with its own scale and does not collide with the explanatory text.

reviewed_pages.title: 主体剖面与卡带插入空间
reviewed_pages.observations: A-A Y=0 and B-B Y=35 are separately titled; cut material is visible in a light fill. Shell, board and connector section lines and captions are not clipped or overlapped.

reviewed_pages.title: 主机与手柄的分层装配
reviewed_pages.observations: Exploded drawing occupies a substantial central area; upper/lower shells, mainboard, cartridge layers and controller layers are distinguishable. Drawing and caption are contained above the text block. Cable omission is expressly disclosed.

reviewed_pages.title: 主板与主要集成电路（VA2）
reviewed_pages.observations: Mainboard and enlarged package views are clear. Approximate 245, 182 and 83 dimension labels are visible. MEGADRIVE-0103 is retained and the title, lead and board marking communicate the VA2 study scope.

reviewed_pages.title: 卡带触点、散热片与控制传动
reviewed_pages.observations: Two contact rows, heat spreader and control mechanism views are distinct with separate captions. Approximate 105 is visible. Simplified mechanism scope is disclosed.

reviewed_pages.title: 空白卡带与外接适配器
reviewed_pages.observations: Blank cartridge and adapter views are legible; approximate 110 and 69 labels have margins. Study labels and no-game-data/electrical-design limitations are visible.

reviewed_pages.title: 原始连接线与插头结构
reviewed_pages.observations: DIN-to-two-RCA arrangement and DE-9/DC plug details have separate readable captions and scales. Displayed cable geometry is expressly described as stored positioning and short segments, not original cable length.

reviewed_pages.title: 组件与显示材料索引
reviewed_pages.observations: All nine table rows, quantities, display-material roles and non-contiguous component identifier ranges are readable without clipping. The 825 component / 1209 solid total is present.

reviewed_pages.title: 版本依据、近似边界与验证入口
reviewed_pages.observations: Source/version, dimension scope, validation records and reproduction paths are visible and distinct. VA2 versus earliest VA0 and local study approximations are explicitly stated. Appendix paths and footer fit within the page.

remaining_scope_limits: This is an explicitly approximate VA2-based educational model and drawing set; this review does not establish manufacturing accuracy or a functioning circuit.
